patches.name: Accept upload authorization that carries no upload form
patches.description: Uploads the file when the sync server authorizes an upload without an S3 form envelope. Without this, an authorization the server completed is thrown away as a parse error and the attachment never uploads.

patches.name: Custom sync server
patches.description: Redirects Zotero's sync API and live-update stream to your own server.

options.title: Server address
options.description: HTTPS origin of your self-hosted Zotero server, for example https://zotero.example.org. Only the host (with an optional port) is accepted: no path and no trailing slash. A missing scheme is assumed to be https://.

options.title: Streaming address (optional)
options.description: Full WebSocket URL for live updates, for example wss://zotero.example.org/stream or ws://zotero.example.org/stream. A path is allowed. Leave empty to derive it from the server address as wss://<server>/stream.

patches.name: Custom sync server: allow cleartext streaming
patches.description: Adds the chosen streaming host to the app's cleartext allow-list when the stream URL is ws:// or http://.

patches.name: Enable verbose logging
patches.description: Plants Timber's debug tree so the app's own log lines reach logcat. Diagnostics only — expect a lot of output.

patches.name: Recover attachments with an unusable MD5
patches.description: Uploads attachments whose stored MD5 is empty or malformed, instead of sending an unusable digest the server rejects. Without this, the attachment's file never uploads and never reaches other devices.

patches.name: Recover attachments with an unusable modification time
patches.description: Uploads attachments whose stored modification time cannot be parsed, instead of skipping them forever. Without this, an attachment whose mtime is empty never uploads its file.

patches.name: Send attachment uploads as the file itself
patches.description: Sends an attachment upload without the multipart form around it when the server authorized the upload without an S3 form. Workaround for servers that take the bytes themselves; uploads that carry a form are unaffected.
